notes: The final clause is verbless with an adverbial predicate, so rule 53 gives the supplied copula to εὐθέως and not to the subject τὸ τέλος, against the ASV's word order; rule 96 keeps the bare negator οὐκ from being the carrier.
οὐκ stands with an adverb that is not itself a negative, so rules 41 and 59 do not empty it.
